## What's new in 1.2.0

**Five more releases: twelve in all, 284 modules.**

| Release | Year | Modules |
|---|---|---|
| Marvel Comics Screen Posters | 1993 | 1 (36 posters) |
| Snoopy's Screen Savers | 1994 | 8 |
| The Looney Tunes Screen Saver | 1995 | 12 |
| ScreamSavers | 1995 | 15 |
| The Disney Collection Screen Saver | 1995 | 16 |

The importer takes them from your own copies, including ZIPs that keep each disk in a folder of its own and InstallShield floppy sets. It can also download them from the Internet Archive. Snoopy's Screen Savers was an add-on that relied on your After Dark's sound library, so Long After Dark now supplies a built-in one. Marvel's poster transitions appear instantly.

**Linux.** A native X11 player runs the same programs under Wine: full screen, in a window, or as an XScreenSaver display mode. See the Linux zip below and [docs/LINUX.md](https://github.com/starrlord/longafterdark/blob/v1.2.0/docs/LINUX.md).
